intro: Special Delivery for Gaxim represents the return leg of an Alliance courier mission between Stormwind City and the wilds of Kalimdor. Collin Mauren provides a specialized Scroll of Messaging to take back to the gnome tinkerer Gaxim Rustfizzle in the Stonetalon Mountains. The scroll contains the arcane component needed to construct a remote explosive against local deforestation efforts.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here you are, friend. This should do nicely.
Please give my regards to Gaxim when next you see him. I look forward to hearing about this adventure when it sees its completion.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Haha! You're back! Do you have it? Do you have the spell?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is perfect, friend! Well done.
This spell, mixed with the NG-5, shall make the perfect remote explosive.
We'll be able to create the perfect distraction for you so you can sneak in and steal the Venture Co.'s letters and engineering plans.
That will surely slow down their deforestation acts.
